ios.desc:
This new comprehensive wellness tool is your guide to daily sessions of breathing exercises, cold exposure, and mind-powering practices. Witness a transformative impact on your life, leading to increased energy, reduced stress, better sleep, and expedited recovery. It is more than just a breathing app, it is your guide to the Wim Hof Method practice and a stress-free life.

Discover the transformative power of the Wim Hof Method, backed by extensive scientific research. This unique approach to wellness influences your immune and autonomic nervous systems, along with the critical mind-body connection, bolstering physical strength and mental resilience. Across decades of dancing with the cold, the Iceman set 26 world records and broke a Guinness World Record 18 times. Grounded in rigorous studies, the Wim Hof Method isn't just a wellness practice; it's a scientifically validated pathway to enhanced health, well-being, and resilience. Experience its impact today..

BREATHING EXERCISES
• Increase energy, alkalize the body, stimulate the vagus nerve, activate brown fat, and achieve calm sleep through various guided breathing techniques
• Immerse yourself in the breathwork practices with the help of Wim Hof's voice, and connect with your breath
• Suit your needs with the fully customized Guided Breathing bubble - pre-set the rounds and connect to your Spotify or Apple Music playlist

COLD EXPOSURE
• Boost immunity and reduce inflammation with cold water therapy practices
• Have cold become your warm friend through your daily Guided Cold Showers, Guided Ice Baths, Feet, or Hands-in-Ice practices!
• Increase your cold tolerance with the 20-Day Cold Shower Challenge and watch your sleep deepen effortlessly

POWER OF THE MIND
• Improve focus, resilience, and discipline with the power of the mind exercises
• Create routines that support your well-being with Wim's Challenges
• Increase strength and flexibility with Body weight and Equipment exercises

GUIDED MEDITATIONS
• Find your equilibrium among the business of modern life with Guided Meditations directly from Wim

AUDIO
• Find out what is on Wim´s mind through Contemplations
• Immerse yourself in real stories through the Iceman Speaks 
• Discover the method through the 30-Day Audio Challenge

E-LEARNING & CONTENT
• Access your purchased Video Courses all in one place
• Explore the exciting world of Wim through our Comic

RESULTS & CALENDAR
• Track your swift improvement over time with a clear Calendar & Bar Chart
